svg.title: The seawall: a low sea wall with a white balustrade of turned balusters between piers, a lawn verge with benches, the paved promenade the player travels on, four lamp standards, two western red cedars, gulls and four people. World y 900..1330; TRANSPARENT above world 1150 - the cedars, the lamps and the gulls stand up into the sky - and opaque below it. Drawn from refs/vancouver/seawall-path-and-harbour.jpg. Every object is a TYPE: this tile repeats every 1920 px, so nothing on it may identify a place, and the six figures carry NO cultural marker of any kind (docs/content-review.md 3.3, outcome 2).
